title: ImageCaptioner2: Image Captioner for Image Captioning Bias Amplification Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Masking visual human regions and gender-indicative words in generated captions, appending a prompt template (e.g., 'Therefore, the gender is [Answer]'), and using a fine-tuned prompt-based image captioner to measure prediction confidence and relative bias amplification.

Masking visual human regions and race-indicative words in generated captions, appending a prompt template (e.g., 'Therefore, The race is [Answer]'), and using a fine-tuned prompt-based image captioner to measure prediction confidence and relative bias amplification.

Masking sentimental or emotion-leaking words in generated captions, appending a prompt template (e.g., 'Therefore, the emotion is [Answer]'), and using a fine-tuned prompt-based image captioner to measure prediction confidence and relative bias amplification.
